content.text:
The self-check machines now accept card numbers with spaces or dashes, such as `2123 4000 5678 90` or `2123-4000-5678-90`. All 60 tests pass.

`parseCheckoutRequest` in `lib/selfcheck/sip2.js` now removes spaces and dashes from the card number field before the member lookup. I put it there because the new scanners cause the problem, so only the self-check path changes. `findMemberByCard` and the stored card numbers are untouched.

I added a test in `test/sip2.test.js` that checks out an item with spaced, dashed and mixed card numbers. A badly formatted number is still refused as `unknown-member`.

My first attempt to apply the edits as a Python script was denied. I made the same changes with the Edit tool instead.

I haven't committed anything.
